findings.title: ESMFold2 native import uses stale 76 aa policy
findings.impact: N01 fails in 2.085 s before inference; structure-dependent calculations unavailable.
findings.recommendation: Apply prepared r06 only after fresh idle/rollout preflight; verify actual interpreter PYTHONPATH and imported policy/profile, then validate a new independent 233 aa run. Do not equate policy admission with inference support.

findings.title: BLAST coverage formatter rejected by parser
findings.impact: Native BLAST exits 0 after 2902.964 s; four valid near-full coverage rows reject all 500 HSPs.
findings.recommendation: Validate integer qcovhsp using the fixed tool formatting behavior, retain exact interval coverage for threshold decisions, add near-99/full-100/corruption regression cases and archived-byte replay. Do not widen all numeric tolerances or change scientific thresholds.

findings.title: Primary markdown and HiMat card omit concrete upstream failures
findings.impact: COMPLETED card lists only seven generic gaps; N01 TOOL_FAILED and N03 OUTPUT_INVALID are absent. Outer workflow-report.md retains both.
findings.recommendation: Project structured parent/child failures and conditional skips into both readable report and card; distinguish report delivery from computational completeness; expose N10 partial and N17 scan_invocations=0. Preserve existing card discriminator.

findings.title: Generic HiMat entry cannot reach design execution even with suitable gate
findings.impact: HiMat sends neither m1_test nor validated design constraints; generic N11/N12/N13/N14 always return a skip reason. Fixing N01 alone does not enable ProteinMPNN.
findings.recommendation: Implement a general sequence-bound engineering design request under approved constraint provenance and true applicability gate; retain unknown protections, never reuse fixed 1UBQ masks, and verify both design and WT/missing-input branches. Remaining input/policy decisions belong to designated management/science owners.

findings.title: Progress omits reconciling and counts internal records as business nodes
findings.impact: Historical N03 reconciling is projected to current_nodes=[]; this generic run has 20 internal records for 18 unique business nodes.
findings.recommendation: Include active reconciliation/stop state with accurate semantics, group by N01..N18, and report successful/failed/skipped counts separately.

findings.title: Generic child failure propagation differs from M1 and synchronous exception path
findings.impact: Generic child OUTPUT_INVALID is absorbed while direct OUTPUT_INVALID exceptions are fatal; this run ends parent succeeded/completed_with_gaps. Missing inputs and execution failures lack a shared explicit classification.
findings.recommendation: Separate allowed missing-input degradation from real execution/integrity failures consistently across dispatch/resume; follow approved failure policy, and retain diagnostic delivery without labelling computation complete. Add generic-entry failure-path checks, not only m1_test checks.
